name: Micky Thunder
caption: The owner of Red Star Wrestling for six weeks of 2009: named owner by the Bizarre Ministry on 7 April and reported dead in the fed's own news on 21 May.

tenures.source: Its news of 7 April 2009 names him the new owner of Red Star Wrestling, chosen by the Bizarre Ministry; its news of 21 May 2009 says he has passed away.

name: Alex Coslov
caption: Met Bone Smasher for the RSW Championship and ownership of the fed in a Scaffold Ladder Match on 7 April 2009, after which the Bizarre Ministry vacated the title and fired him.

tenures.source: Its news of 7 April 2009: he faced Bone Smasher for the Red Star Wrestling Championship and 100% ownership in a Scaffold Ladder Match, and was then fired by the new owner.

name: Bone Smasher
caption: The challenger in the Scaffold Ladder Match for the RSW Championship and ownership of the fed, after fifteen shows of build-up.

tenures.source: Its news of 7 April 2009: he faced Alex Coslov for the Red Star Wrestling Championship and 100% of the company in a Scaffold Ladder Match after fifteen shows of build-up.

identity.note: The same name stands on 2 other wing records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Thundercrism
caption: One of the two leaders of the Bizarre Ministry, who named the fed's new owner on 7 April 2009.

tenures.source: Its news of 7 April 2009: named as one half of the Bizarre Ministry's leadership, who announced Micky Thunder as the buyer.
